title: [IMP-7] MLS credential format and the leaf-to-DID binding are undefined
description: Review finding IMP-7: MLS credential format and the leaf-to-DID binding are undefined (lens IMP). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:55, :79-80; spec/02-identity.md:80; spec/12-security.md:258-260; spec/09-interop.md:28-36. Fix: Part of this is already stated: 02:80 says "Each device signs with its own Ed25519 device key: its MLS leaf signatures", so `signature_key` = a device `authentication` key. Still undefined: the credential type and the bytes of `identity` (no grep hit for BasicCredential or credential type), how key bytes are matched, and the P-256 conflict (12:258 allows P-256 authentication keys, while 05:46 mandates the Ed25519-only suite 0x0001). Forbid P-256 for MLS leaves. The MIMI credential at 09:32 has no MLS encoding. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
